_doc: Starter sets for /diary_setup_init <name> (pack.py, Diary.setup_init; originally `python -m backend.cli setup init`).
`templates` is a list of shipped question-set ids to install, or "all" = every shipped set except the ones
marked "default_hidden": true (shipped, but only brought in by hand). Sets not installed are marked as
already handled, so they do not appear later either; /diary_tpl_restore <id> brings one in.
Without setup init a new person gets the same as "all".
`settings` are written to the preferences (only keys not yet set by the person).
Nothing here ever deletes anything: running init again only adds what was never handled.
